convert_xmod_checkpoint_to_pytorch: convert a fairseq X-MOD checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model with weight copying and validation
run_xmod_checkpoint_conversion_cli: run the X-MOD checkpoint conversion CLI tool with fairseq checkpoint path and output directory arguments
build_xmod_masked_lm_from_fairseq: build a HuggingFace XmodForMaskedLM model from a fairseq X-MOD checkpoint with copied weights
build_xmod_classification_model_from_fai: build a HuggingFace XmodForSequenceClassification model from a fairseq X-MOD checkpoint with classification head
verify_xmod_conversion_outputs: verify the converted X-MOD model produces matching outputs against the original fairseq model
